events.title: HavenCraft Demo Update: Alpha 6.0.2
events.summary: Hey everyone, I hope you're having a great time with the demo. And thanks for all the feedback so far! This update just brings a couple minor hotfixes: Villagers no longer show “Inventory full” when they are actually missing a tree on their woodcutter plot. Fixed an issue where grass would grow half a meter misaligned to the streets you painted after loading a save. events.title: Devlog #18 - HavenCraft Steam Demo in 2 weeks, Sept 24th!

We want to prepare for a good launch into Early Access later this year, so Alpha 6 contains A LOT of small changes that make the experience overall smoother, clearer, and just straight up better. events.title: The Seasons Update Is Available For Early Playtesting!
events.summary: Hello everyone!before we launch into Early Access, we are running early playtests off Steam to find bugs and gather feedback already. Today, we're releasing Alpha 5, the Seasons Update!If you want to join early playtesting, try out the current state, and give us feedback you can sign up here:https://havencraft.dionicsoftware.com/Check out the changelog for the seasons update here: https://havencraft.dionicsoftware.com/changelog/alpha-5.0.2/We're looking forward to your opinions!Happy playing!

events.title: Devlog #15 - Seasons & Trailer
events.summary: Hello everyone and welcome to HavenCraft!We've been releasing Alpha builds for playtesting before Early Access on our website.Join the playtests and see additional info about HavenCraft here.Now, we're getting close to the pre-Early Access Alpha 5 release! Our target date is in 2 weeks, on Wednesday, May 27th. We're going to do a small weekly series of posts leading up to the release so you know what's new.
